criteria.behavior: spikes/codex-cu/ is self-contained: stdlib-Python orchestrator, vendored codex path pinned (build/vendor/CodexRuntime/bin/codex 0.160.0), no npm/pip deps, .gitignore covers home/ (CODEX_HOME + auth.json symlink), no files outside owned set touched; dirty-baseline captured at M1
criteria.check: `ls spikes/codex-cu` shows appserver.py/probe.py/tasks.json/run.py/report.py/results/; `grep -rn 'CodexRuntime/bin/codex\|0.160' spikes/codex-cu/*.py` hits; `cat spikes/codex-cu/.gitignore` includes home/; python3 one-liner diffs `git status --porcelain` + `git diff` vs spikes/codex-cu/results/dirty-baseline.txt showing 0 NEW non-owned hunks; `git show --name-only --format=` on phase commits shows only owned paths
criteria.expected: Spike standalone; results committed; no production or bench files in phase commits

criteria.behavior: probe records REAL state via actual app-server protocol calls: vendored codex version, computer_use feature state, auth mode, configRequirements response incl. ComputerUseRequirements fields AS RETURNED (nulls recorded as nulls — requirements are declared constraints, distinct from writable Config.computer_use), effective config, model catalog incl. sol family
criteria.check: `python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('spikes/codex-cu/results/results.json')); print(d['probe'])"` shows populated fields incl. the requirements object verbatim; `grep -n 'configRequirements' spikes/codex-cu/probe.py` shows a real RPC call; probe exits non-zero or rows mark blocked_env when auth/init fails
criteria.expected: Probe block populated with protocol-derived values; requirements vs config not conflated

criteria.behavior: >=3 canary GUI tasks attempted via app-server thread/start + turn/start, each row carrying: per-run unique MARK, wall_ms, turn status, cu_evidence (item-stream signatures proving actual computer-tool calls — shell/open -a successes WITHOUT cu evidence are ok_no_cu, not ok), tokens, and INDEPENDENT end-state verification (AppleScript/AX/file checks with pre-run state snapshot — never the agent's claim)
criteria.check: `python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('spikes/codex-cu/results/results.json')); print([ (r['task'],r['status'],r.get('cu_evidence'),r.get('verify')) for r in d['rows'] if r.get('kind')=='task'])"` lists rows with MARK/cu_evidence/verify; verifier implementations exist in run.py or tasks.json; recompute task count
criteria.expected: Canary rows with independent verification AND computer-use proof; no claimed-but-unverified successes

criteria.behavior: unattended-approvals matrix executed with a PINNED shared base (fresh CODEX_HOME per variant, same model/effort/sandbox, effective_config captured): which config ran computer-use turns with ZERO human clicks (scoped / never / auto_review / persistent / default), event-log excerpts showing approvals requested vs auto-resolved, TCC grant events recorded separately from zero-click claims
criteria.check: `python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('spikes/codex-cu/results/results.json')); print([ (r['variant'],r['status'],r.get('approvals')) for r in d['rows'] if r.get('kind')=='variant'])"` shows variant rows; run logs contain approval request/resolution events; REPORT.md's named working config matches raw events
criteria.expected: Named approval mode + effective-config evidence; no hand-waving

criteria.behavior: background/multi-user session section exists as LABELED hypotheses (allowLockedComputerUse semantics, switched-out WindowServer actuation, per-session TCC, jevbench gap) with each claim tagged verified / documented / unverified — no categorical claims without evidence
criteria.check: REPORT.md + phase file contain the section; every claim carries a label; grep for unlabeled categorical claims on background sessions
criteria.expected: Honest split between measured, documented, and unverified findings

criteria.behavior: REPORT.md has measurements table + verdict matching the PREDECLARED rule: PROMOTE iff >=2 canary ok rows carry cu_evidence under a zero-click unattended config; DISCARD on systematic no-CU or human-required failures; CONDITIONAL only with the named condition; this-session success never presented as background-session proof
criteria.check: verdict text in REPORT.md + phase Decision Log cites the rule and the rows it matched; handoff names what P-next builds or why discarded
criteria.expected: Verdict recorded with numbers against the declared bar

criteria.behavior: secrets hygiene: no API keys/tokens in spike files or logs; auth uses existing codex login only; child env restricted; CODEX_HOME (with auth.json symlink) under gitignored spikes/codex-cu/home/ and never committed
